Acoustic distances with measurement error - Use the PCA on MFCC descriptors from `choosing_vocal_convergence_metric.qmd` (PCs explaining 90% of variance), keeping individual/blocks with at least 10 calls. Unlike previous versions, **acoustic block 1 is kept** as the baseline, and the minimum is lowered from 25 to **10 calls**: the bootstrap SE below down-weights imprecise distances, so birds with 10 to 24 calls can contribute instead of being discarded (below 10 calls the Euclidean distance itself becomes unreliable) - For each pair of birds from the same group recorded in the same block, compute the **mean Euclidean distance** $E\|X - Y\|$ between the calls of the two birds in PC space (all call-to-call distances averaged). Unlike the Euclidean distance, this does not subtract each bird's own within-bird variability, so birds with more spread-out calls are not corrected. It is 0 only when every call of the two birds coincides - Its precision depends on how many calls each bird has (10 to > 1,000), so a **bootstrap standard error** is estimated by resampling each bird's calls (100 replicates) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dist_file <- "./data/processed/euclidean_distances_bootstrap_min10calls.RDS" if (!file.exists(dist_file)) { set.seed(123) n_boot <- 100 pca_dat <- readRDS("./data/processed/pca_dat.RDS") pcs <- grep("^PC", names(pca_dat), value = TRUE) pca_dat$id_block <- paste(pca_dat$ID, pca_dat$record.block, sep = "_") # keep individual/blocks with at least 10 calls (all blocks, # including block 1) call_counts <- table(pca_dat$id_block) pca_dat <- pca_dat[pca_dat$id_block %in% names(call_counts)[call_counts >= 10], ] # mean Euclidean distance between the calls of two birds, # from a call-to-call distance matrix euclid_from_D <- function(D, ia, ib) { mean(D[ia, ib]) } grp_blk <- unique(pca_dat[, c("record.group", "record.block")]) out <- pblapply(seq_len(nrow(grp_blk)), function(i) { Y <- pca_dat[pca_dat$record.group == grp_blk$record.group[i] & pca_dat$record.block == grp_blk$record.block[i], ] ids <- sort(unique(Y$ID)) if (length(ids) < 2) return(NULL) # all call-to-call distances in this group/block D <- as.matrix(dist(as.matrix(Y[, pcs]))) rows <- lapply(ids, function(id) which(Y$ID == id)) names(rows) <- ids pairs <- t(combn(ids, 2)) do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(j) { ia <- rows[[pairs[j, 1]]] ib <- rows[[pairs[j, 2]]] boot <- replicate(n_boot, euclid_from_D(D, sample(ia, replace = TRUE), sample(ib, replace = TRUE))) data.frame(indiv.1 = pairs[j, 1], indiv.2 = pairs[j, 2], time = grp_blk$record.block[i], n.calls.1 = length(ia), n.calls.2 = length(ib), dist = euclid_from_D(D, ia, ib), dist_se = sd(boot)) })) }) dist_dists <- do.call(rbind, out) rownames(dist_dists) <- NULL saveRDS(dist_dists, dist_file) } dist_dists <- readRDS(dist_file) # dyads per acoustic block table(time = dist_dists$time) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` time 1 2 3 4 5 66 57 54 50 47 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dist_dists$min_calls <- pmin(dist_dists$n.calls.1, dist_dists$n.calls.2) ggplot(dist_dists, aes(x = min_calls, y = dist_se)) + geom_point(color = mako(10)[5], alpha = 0.7) + scale_x_log10() + labs(x = "Calls of the bird with fewer calls (log scale)", y = "Bootstrap SE of Euclidean distance") + theme_classic() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](stats_v06_euclidean_files/figure-html/plot Euclidean distance precision-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: ## Social data aligned to acoustic blocks - Social blocks were recorded during the following acoustic block in all 12 groups (midpoint dates within 0.1 to 2.4 days): **social block *k* corresponds to acoustic block *k + 1***. A common time index `time` (= acoustic block, 1 to 5) is used, with social data available for times 2 to 5 - The block alignment is checked below from the recording dates of the proximity videos and the acoustic recordings. The affiliative and agonistic edge lists have no dates and are assumed to follow the same block numbering as the proximity data - Proximity: number of scans in which the two birds were < 10 cm apart (`n_close`) out of the scans in which both birds were visible (`n_valid`) - Affiliative and agonistic interactions: number of interactions in either direction per dyad and block (0 when the dyad does not appear in that block's edge list) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")) prox_raw <- read.csv("./data/raw/Proximity_Raw_Data_R.csv") prox_raw$date <- as.Date(prox_raw$Video_date, "%d-%b-%y") sel_meta <- read.csv("./data/raw/sp_selections_analysis_metadata.csv") sel_meta$date <- as.Date(sel_meta$date.format) alignment <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(prox_raw$Group)), function(g) { soc_mid <- tapply(prox_raw$date[prox_raw$Group == g], prox_raw$block[prox_raw$Group == g], mean) ac_mid <- tapply(sel_meta$date[sel_meta$record.group == g], sel_meta$record.block[sel_meta$record.group == g], mean) data.frame(group = g, social_block = as.numeric(names(soc_mid)), acoustic_block_same_dates = as.numeric(sapply(soc_mid, function(s) names(ac_mid)[which.min(abs(ac_mid - s))])), days_apart = sapply(soc_mid, function(s) round(min(abs(ac_mid - s)), 1))) })) table(social_block = alignment$social_block, acoustic_block = alignment$acoustic_block_same_dates) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` acoustic_block social_block 2 3 4 5 1 12 0 0 0 2 0 12 0 0 3 0 0 12 0 4 0 0 0 12 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} range(alignment$days_apart) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.1 2.4 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} stopifnot(all(alignment$acoustic_block_same_dates == alignment$social_block + 1)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # proximity: close and valid scans per dyad and social block prox_raw$pair <- paste(prox_raw$Neighbor_1, prox_raw$Neighbor_2, sep = "_") prox_agg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(prox_raw, list(prox_raw$pair, prox_raw$block), drop = TRUE), function(x) { data.frame( pair = x$pair[1], indiv.1 = x$Neighbor_1[1], indiv.2 = x$Neighbor_2[1], group = paste0("g", x$Group[1]), treatment = x$Treatment[1], time = x$block[1] + 1, # social block k = acoustic block k + 1 n_close = sum(x$Distance_cm < 10, na.rm = TRUE), n_valid = sum(!is.na(x$Distance_cm)) ) })) # affiliative and agonistic interactions per dyad and social block count_interactions <- function(prefix) { files <- list.files("./data/raw", pattern = paste0("^", prefix, "_g.*_block[0-9]\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE) do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(x) { Y <- read.csv(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) if (nrow(Y) == 0) return(NULL) names(Y)[1:2] <- c("actor", "recipient") block <- as.numeric(gsub("block|\\.csv", "", strsplit(basename(x), "_")[[1]][4])) pairs <- apply(Y[, c("actor", "recipient")], 1, function(z) paste(sort(z), collapse = "_")) tab <- table(pairs) data.frame(pair = names(tab), time = block + 1, n = as.vector(tab)) })) } aff_counts <- count_interactions("aff") ago_counts <- count_interactions("ago") social <- prox_agg social$affiliative <- 0 social$agonistic <- 0 key_soc <- paste(social$pair, social$time) social$affiliative[match(paste(aff_counts$pair, aff_counts$time), key_soc)] <- aff_counts$n social$agonistic[match(paste(ago_counts$pair, ago_counts$time), key_soc)] <- ago_counts$n # check that all interaction records matched a dyad in the proximity data stopifnot(all(paste(aff_counts$pair, aff_counts$time) %in% key_soc), all(paste(ago_counts$pair, ago_counts$time) %in% key_soc)) head(social) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: ## Combined dyad x time dataset - One row per dyad and time (acoustic block 1 to 5); acoustic data are missing when one of the birds had fewer than 10 calls in that block, and social data are missing at time 1 - Predictors are standardized: acoustic dissimilarity (Euclidean distance) and its SE are divided by the SD of Euclidean distance, proximity enters as the proportion of close scans and interaction counts as log(count + 1), each z-scored - Lagged (previous block) and lead (next block) values are computed within dyad, only when the adjacent block exists ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dyads <- unique(social[, c("pair", "indiv.1", "indiv.2", "group", "treatment")]) dat <- merge(dyads, data.frame(time = 1:5)) dat <- merge(dat, social[, c("pair", "time", "n_close", "n_valid", "affiliative", "agonistic")], by = c("pair", "time"), all.x = TRUE) dist_dists$pair <- paste(dist_dists$indiv.1, dist_dists$indiv.2, sep = "_") dat <- merge(dat, dist_dists[, c("pair", "time", "dist", "dist_se")], by = c("pair", "time"), all.x = TRUE) dat <- dat[order(dat$pair, dat$time), ] # standardize (names without underscores keep brms parameter # names simple) ac_mean <- mean(dat$dist, na.rm = TRUE) ac_sd <- sd(dat$dist, na.rm = TRUE) dat$ac <- (dat$dist - ac_mean)/ac_sd dat$acse <- dat$dist_se/ac_sd z <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x)) dat$prox <- z(dat$n_close/dat$n_valid) dat$ago <- z(log1p(dat$agonistic)) dat$aff <- z(log1p(dat$affiliative)) dat$treatment <- factor(dat$treatment, levels = c("Old", "Young")) # previous and next block values within dyad shift_by_time <- function(d, vars, k) { for (v in vars) { d[[paste0(v, ifelse(k > 0, "lag", "lead"))]] <- d[[v]][match(d$time - k, d$time)] } d } lag_vars <- c("ac", "acse", "prox", "ago", "aff") dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(dat, dat$pair), function(d) { d <- shift_by_time(d, lag_vars, 1) shift_by_time(d, c("prox", "ago", "aff"), -1) })) rownames(dat) <- NULL write.csv(dat, "./data/processed/dyad_by_time_euclidean_aligned.csv", row.names = FALSE) # rows usable by each model n_models <- data.frame(model = c("Model 1: social during period -> acoustic change", "Model 2: cross-lagged, acoustic response", "Model 2: cross-lagged, social responses", "Placebo: next period social -> acoustic change", "stats_v05 lagged models (misaligned blocks)"), rows = c(sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "prox", "ago", "aff")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "proxlag", "agolag", "afflag")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("aclag", "prox", "proxlag", "ago", "agolag", "aff", "afflag")])), sum(complete.cases(dat[, c("ac", "aclag", "proxlead", "agolead", "afflead")])), 77)) n_models ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} corr_mat <- cor(dat[, c("ac", "prox", "ago", "aff")], use = "pairwise.complete.obs") cols <- mako(10, alpha = 0.8, begin = 0.2, end = 0.75) ggcorrplot(corr_mat, type = "lower", lab = TRUE, lab_size = 4, colors = c(cols[1], "white", cols[10]), title = "Pairwise correlations (same time)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](stats_v06_euclidean_files/figure-html/predictor correlations-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Statistical analysis ## Helpers for model summaries - Small functions used to write the summary boxes after each model, so that the numbers (and whether an effect counts as credible) are always computed from the fitted models in this document - An effect is called **credible** when its 95% CI excludes zero, **suggestive** when the probability of direction (pd) is >= 0.95 but the 95% CI still includes zero, and **not supported** otherwise. LOO comparisons treat |elpd_diff| < 4 or |elpd_diff| / SE < 2 as indistinguishable ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} iterations <- 4000 warmup <- 2000 # convergence diagnostics on population-level and variance # parameters fit_diag <- function(fit) { np <- nuts_params(fit) drws <- posterior::subset_draws(posterior::as_draws_df(fit), variable = "^(b_|sd_|sigma|shape|phi)", regex = TRUE) smry <- posterior::summarise_draws(drws, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") list(ndiv = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]), ndraws = posterior::ndraws(fit), rhat = max(smry$rhat, na.rm = TRUE), ess_bulk = min(smry$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE), ess_tail = min(smry$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE), n = nrow(fit$data)) } diag_text <- function(d) { ok_mix <- d$rhat <= 1.01 && min(d$ess_bulk, d$ess_tail) >= 400 verdict <- if (d$ndiv == 0 && ok_mix) { "the chains converged to a common posterior and the reported medians and CIs are not limited by sampling noise" } else if (ok_mix && d$ndiv/d$ndraws < 0.005) { "the few divergences (< 0.5% of draws) are unlikely to bias the estimates, although raising `adapt_delta` further would be needed to remove them entirely" } else { "the estimates should be treated with caution until the sampler problems are resolved" } paste0("Across 4 chains x ", iterations, " iterations (", warmup, " warmup; n = ", d$n, " rows) there were ", d$ndiv, " divergent transitions, the largest R-hat is ", sprintf("%.3f", d$rhat), " and the minimum bulk and tail ESS are ", round(d$ess_bulk), " and ", round(d$ess_tail), " (rule of thumb: R-hat <= 1.01 and ESS >= ~400), so ", verdict, ".") } # name of the single parameter matching a pattern (e.g. # coefficients of multivariate responses) find_par <- function(fit, pattern) { nm <- grep(pattern, posterior::variables(fit), value = TRUE) if (length(nm) != 1) stop("pattern '", pattern, "' matched: ", paste(nm, collapse = ", ")) nm } # posterior summary of a single coefficient coef_stats <- function(fit, pattern) { x <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)[[find_par(fit, pattern)]] list(est = median(x), lo = unname(quantile(x, 0.025)), hi = unname(quantile(x, 0.975)), pd = max(mean(x > 0), mean(x < 0))) } fmt_coef <- function(cs) { sprintf("median = %.2f, 95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f], pd = %.3f", cs$est, cs$lo, cs$hi, cs$pd) } support <- function(cs) { if (cs$lo > 0 || cs$hi < 0) "credible" else if (cs$pd >= 0.95) "suggestive" else "not supported" } # sentence describing an effect;
